test_async_packager_end_to_end: test the AsyncPackager class to batch packageables and await their executable results
test_package_with_extra_packageables: test the AsyncPackager.package method with extra packageables passed as an argument
test_package_is_required: test that awaiting an executable before calling package raises PackageHasNotBeenCalledError
test_awaitable_is_picklable: test that AsyncPackager awaitables can be pickled and unpickled across event loops
test_awaitable_is_repeatedly_picklable: test that pickled AsyncPackager awaitables produce identical serialized output on repeated dumps
